newsitem.title: USA: Georgia Power Hatch 2 returns to full power.
newsitem.headline: Georgia Power Hatch 2 returns to full power.

text.p: Georgia Power Co's 765 megawatt (MW) Hatch 2 nuclear unit is operating at full power Monday after reducing to 65 percent power this weekend, the company said.
Plant operators reduced power at the Baxley, Ga., unit to change the configuration of control rods, company spokeswoman Loretto Stevens said, noting the maintenance was scheduled.
The adjacent unit, with a generating capacity of 741 MW, is operating at full power.
Georgia Power is a subsidiary of Southern Co.
